A genuine ImportError/ModuleNotFoundError inside the hexpat package propagates through execute_pattern and is caught in the fixture, triggering pytest.skip. Any structural breakage short of a missing module (syntax error, removed class) now causes RuntimeError which turns tests RED instead of silently skipping the whole file.
